summary: Configured node1-node3 to forward only local0 traffic over mutually authenticated TLS/TCP 6514 to node4. Node4 writes fixed per-source logs, rejects unrelated facilities and cleartext, and retains seven daily compressed rotations. All four nodes passed sequential reboot-persistence testing.
actions_performed: Generated private keys locally on their owning nodes and deployed CA-signed certificates.
Configured persistent TLS forwarding with retry queues on node1-node3.
Configured node4 TLS-only ingestion, per-source logs, firewall access, and log rotation.
Tested TLS delivery, facility filtering, cleartext rejection, rotation, and post-rotation delivery.
Restarted each node exactly once, sequentially, and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: TLS local0 forwarding from node1-node3 to node4:6514
evidence.summary: Configurations validated; every client negotiated trusted TLS and delivered local0 data over an established 6514 connection.

evidence.requirement: Source-identifiable logs and exclusion of unrelated facilities
evidence.summary: local0 probes appeared only in node1.log, node2.log, and node3.log; paired user-facility probes were absent before and after rotation.
A raw syslog connection was reset as an unexpected TLS packet and never stored; final listener evidence shows 6514 only, with no port 514 listener.

evidence.requirement: Daily rotation, at least seven retained rotations, and compression
evidence.summary: Seven gzip generations per source passed integrity checks, generation 7 retained delivered data, reopened logs accepted new traffic, and the daily logrotate timer is active.
